decisions.integrity: each of the 13 checks reports status computed from the DB; corrupting rows flips the matching check to warn/error (13 since M51.A2 split orphan owners from by-design synthetic container references)
decisions.schema: report.schema.version must equal the actual brain_schema_version row

limitations: The WAL-size and ratio sanity checks are environment-dependent; their status is recorded as computed, not forced.

M14-observed defect FIXED by M51.A3: the indexer once stored same-file edges with dangling source ids (dangling-source > 0 on fresh indexes). Since M51, a fresh index must report 0 — a nonzero value now means an indexer regression.
